what: Product-level dead air / cut-ins / WER of the Pipecat and LiveKit (room-less) demos against audioforge.serve serving runs/stage1_turn_v3_trail6.afm with --turn-input diar (the head/input of EOT_BENCH_V2 section 7), default diarizer preset low_latency_032; policies timeout 1000 (control), head theta 0.98, hybrid theta 0.998 at 1000/4000 ms, hybrid theta 0.99 (chosen in-sample from the served head's max-eot distribution) at 1000/4000 ms
windows: the 5 AMI dev turn windows of research/archive/INTEGRATION.md section 4 (ES2011b_027, IB4002_119, IS1008b_003, IS1008b_014, TS3004b_064); WAVs/refs reused from scratchpad wf-integ/{pipecat/ami,livekit/audio}
server: PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m audioforge.serve --asr runs/stage1_turn_v3_trail6.afm --diar runs/nemo_sortformer_v2.afm --turn-input diar --port P --threads 2 --debug-fields; one server per session, CPU, 2 threads, 1x real time
checkpoint_check: stage1_turn_v3_trail6.afm heads: rnnt, ctc, vad, eou, spk, diar, turn; encoder (657 tensors), heads.rnnt (11) and heads.vad (4) are bit-identical to stage1_heads_pretrained.afm; only heads.turn differs (13 vs 10 tensors; needs_cols=True so --turn-input auto also selects diar)
hybrid_driver: as in integration_deadair_032.json: scratch driver deadair032t6/drive.py widens the demos' POLICIES whitelist at runtime and calls the unmodified run_files/amain; no repo code edited
pads: Pipecat pad 3.0 s, LiveKit tail 2.5 s; hybrid 4000 ms runs 5.5 s
definitions: dead_air_ms = arrival of the first product-level 'user stopped' at or after the true end minus the true end (Pipecat: UserStoppedSpeakingFrame at the mock LLM; LiveKit: STT END_OF_SPEECH in stream mode; agent_commit_ms = AgentSession(turn_detection='stt') user-turn commit); decision_minus_true_end_ms = turn_end.t - true end (load independent); cut_ins = decisions while the primary speaks again within 1 s (Pipecat: after its VAD gate and resume_ms=240; LiveKit: every cutting turn_end, from the Pipecat ref primary_intervals); LiveKit sanity_ok = 1 server session, #END_OF_SPEECH == #cutting turn_end, each END_OF_SPEECH right after a FINAL
theta_choice: eot traces from stream_client (--policy both, speed 0) against the trail6+diar server: per-window max eot 0.9915-0.9983 (all reached after the true end); max eot inside primary speech before the end 0.9124-0.9969; 0.998 is reached only in IS1008b_014 (+1.92 s). No theta separates trailing silence from speech in all 5 windows (ES2011b in-speech 0.9969 vs post-end 0.9977). theta 0.99 crosses in the trailing silence of all 5 windows (+0.08 to +2.0 s) and inside speech in ES2011b (-1.44 s) and TS3004b (-2.96 s), the two windows where the 1000 ms timeout also cuts in; theta 0.995 fires post-end in 3/5 with the same two in-speech crossings. 0.99 is chosen in-sample (n = 5) and is not a held-out operating point.
load_note: Sessions PA, PB, LA, LB ran at load 3.2-5.7 (server RTF 0.65-0.91 Pipecat, 0.72-1.09 LiveKit; backlog <= 1.02 s except lk hyb990x1000 IS1008b_014 at 2.84 s). The LiveKit 4000 ms sessions LC/LD ran at load 5.6-10.1 (RTF 0.86-1.08 / 1.07-2.32, backlog up to 11 s) and their re-runs LC2/LD2 at load 8.2-10.1 (RTF 1.0-2.4): the server fell behind, so their dead_air_ms and agent_commit_ms are load-inflated; their decision_minus_true_end_ms are identical between first run and re-run and are the valid numbers. Tags ending in 'r' are the re-runs.

findings.head_reaches_threshold: With --turn-input diar the trail6 head reaches 0.98 in all 5 windows and 0.998 in 4/5 (ES2011b +2.72 s, IS1008b_003 +3.85 s, IS1008b_014 +2.0 s, TS3004b +2.32 s after the true end; IB4002 max 0.9975), but every 0.998 crossing comes after the 1000 ms timeout's decision (+1.28..+2.32 s), and 3 of the 4 fall in the appended silence. So hybrid@0.998/1000 fires at exactly the timeout's decision times on every window; hybrid@0.998/4000 is the head on 4 windows and the 4 s timeout on 1.
findings.theta_0_99: hybrid@0.99/1000 beats the timeout's decision only on ES2011b (+566 vs +1520 ms: Pipecat dead air 1022 vs 1702, LiveKit 995 vs 1697) and, in LiveKit, TS3004b (+400) and IS1008b_014 (+800); Pipecat's resume gate drops those two early firings because other speakers talk within 240 ms. It adds head firings inside the primary's speech (ES2011b -1.12/-1.36 s, TS3004b -2.48 s) that coincide with the timeout's own cut-ins on those windows. With the 4000 ms backstop it is 0.5-3 s slower than the timeout on 4/5 windows.
findings.cut_ins: Pipecat: timeout 4 (3 in the previous run; the resume gate is timing dependent), hybrid 0.998/1000 3, hybrid 0.99/1000 2, hybrid 0.99/4000 1, hybrid 0.998/4000 0, head 0. LiveKit: timeout 5, both 1000 ms hybrids 5, head 1 (+1 early cut at -2.71 s on TS3004b), hybrid 0.99/4000 2, hybrid 0.998/4000 0.
findings.head_alone: head@0.98 (cut policy): Pipecat delivers a turn end in 2/5 windows (IB4002 1461 ms, IS1008b_003 1862 ms); the other 3 firings (ES2011b -1.36 s, IS1008b_014 +0.57 s, TS3004b +0.17 s) are dropped by the adapter's 240 ms resume rule and the head does not re-fire within the 3 s pad. LiveKit (every turn_end counts): dead air 999/613/1475/1867 ms on 4 windows (median 1237) and no post-end decision on ES2011b (it fired at -1.36 s, a cut-in).
findings.wer: identical to section 4 per window (0.2581/0.4333/0.2826/0.3571/0.5818) for every policy: trail6 carries bit-identical encoder, RNNT and VAD weights.
findings.verdict: No product-level improvement over the 1000 ms timeout: same decisions at theta 0.998, +0.6..+2.9 s dead air with the 4 s backstop, and theta 0.99 buys 0.4-1.1 s on 1-3 windows at the price of in-speech firings and an in-sample threshold.
